description: Checks a package.json, lockfile, requirements.txt, go.mod, Cargo.lock, poetry.lock or composer.lock (or a list of packages) against OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities and confirmed-malicious packages. Returns per-package advisory ids (CVE/GHSA/MAL), severity, CVSS and fixed-in versions. Free tier: 30 calls/day per IP with full results, up to 100 packages; then $0.003 per scan (up to 500) in USDC over x402 (/v1/scan).

filename.description: Optional file name, helps type detection

manifest.description: Manifest or lockfile contents (package.json, package-lock.json, requirements.txt, Pipfile.lock, poetry.lock, go.mod, Cargo.lock, composer.lock)

packages.description: Alternative to manifest: [{ecosystem, name, version}], up to 500

name: scan_dependencies
title: Scan a dependency manifest for vulnerable and malicious packages
